nameOrigin: precious stone; game of which Palkia is the mascot

pokedexEntries.di: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

pokedexEntries.prl: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

pokedexEntries.pt: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA’s every breath.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.
